# How to Answer "Tell Me About Yourself" in a Job Interview

**Source:** https://www.instagram.com/reel/DdPPpmgBVS-/ · **Type:** Reel · **Author:** Marnie | Career Coach · **Saved:** 2026-10-17

## Summary

Structure the 'tell me about yourself' interview response into three distinct components: a thesis, key experience, and why this role. This framework presents a cohesive career narrative and highlights key learnings rather than simply reciting resume bullet points.
